# Gratitude

> Gratitude is a free self-care app for iPhone and Android with a gratitude journal, affirmations, Daily Zen and vision boards. No account needed. Made by Hapjoy Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a small team in India, founded by Pritesh Sankhe in 2018.

## Key facts

- Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 260,000 ratings, with over 8 million downloads.
- Free to download and use. Gratitude Pro costs $39.99 a year or $6.99 a month in the US, and prices vary by country.
- Google Play Editors' Choice, and featured by the App Store in the Meet the Developer story "Building a more resilient world" (August 2025): https://apps.apple.com/us/story/id1818561810
- Entries are stored on the device. Optional backup goes to the user's own Google Drive or iCloud.
